record.question: ASEAN stands for
options: Association for South and East Asian Nations
record.explanation: The association names itself Association of Southeast Asian Nations, established 8 August 1967. The printed hyphenated South-East has the same meaning. No current membership count is asserted. Historical exam context: 2016-10 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://asean.org/about-asean/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
